problems: Church is small at thumbnail size
grades.reason: Strongest choice: it shows both features the Examples paragraph names, the former fishpond in the foreground and the ruined church beyond, in their setting in the valley. The other two show only the church.

problems: Chancel has an intact-looking roof, so the ruin is less obvious than the caption implies
grades.reason: A clear, well-framed view of St Martin's church with its graveyard. It shows only one of the two surviving features and does not convey the deserted village setting.

problems: Interior view gives no sense of the village site
grades.reason: The roofless interior plainly shows the church as a ruin. It is still a narrow architectural detail rather than an illustration of the deserted village.
